newsitem.title: USA: Intel launches new 133 mhz MMX processor.
newsitem.headline: Intel launches new 133 mhz MMX processor.

text.p: Intel Corp on Monday launched a new 133 megahertz Pentium-class microprocessor designed for personal computer notebooks that uses Intel's new MMX multimedia technology.
The new chip is available now. It joins the company's line of microchips designed for mobile computing, including the 166 mhz and 150 mhz Pentium processors with MMX technology.

MMX technology allows the central processing unit to process data typically found in multimedia and graphics software simultaneously, which speeds performance, heightens color and provides clearer video and graphics, Intel said.
